motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 13.75 Eagle Mountain City Storm Water Ordinance. City Engineer Chris Trusty presented the item. As part of the Municipal Storm Sewer System permit, Eagle Mountain City was recently audited by the State Department of Environmental Quality to ensure the City's compliance with the general permit. As part of this audit, the State asked for portions of Municipal Code to be updated to reflect the actual language contained in the permit. After presenting requested changes to the City Council, State representatives felt the ordinance as submitted still needed some additional modifications to fully comply with the State discharge permit. These changes are reflected in this update. These changes are found in Titles 13 and 15 of Municipal Code. The amendment adds uncontaminated ground water infiltration, residual street wash water, irrigation water, and lawn watering runoff to the allowed uncontaminated discharge sources permitted in 13.7s.1s0(B). Mayor Westmoreland opened the public hearing at 9:45 p.m. As there were no comments, he closed the hearing
